app.title: Rinde
app.tagline: Does my salary last the month?
app.intro: Your accounts, installments and dollars in one place.

health.heading: System status
health.ok: The API and the database are up.
health.unavailable: The API responds, but the database is unavailable.

brand.label: About Rinde
brand.privacy: No email and no personal data: just a username.
brand.security: Passwords handled the way NIST recommends.
brand.currencies: Pesos, dollars and installments in one place.
brand.footnote: Each square is a day of the month: aqua ones are covered by your salary.

fields.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore.
fields.passwordHelp: {{length}} of at least {{min}} characters. A phrase is safer and easier to remember: “my cat eats noodles on tuesdays”.
fields.recoveryCodeHelp: 20 letters and numbers. You can type it with or without hyphens.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: No email and no personal data: just a username and a phrase you remember.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.subtitle: With the code you saved when you created it. You will choose a new password and every open session will be closed.

code.explain: It is the only way to recover your account if you forget your password. We will not show it again.
code.rotatedNote: Your previous code no longer works.
code.label: Your recovery code
code.copyFailed: Could not copy it. Select the code and copy it manually.
code.confirm: I saved the code somewhere safe

session.waking: Waking up the server: the first visit of the day can take up to a minute.

errors.USERNAME_INVALID: Use 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
errors.USERNAME_RESERVED: That name is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That name is already taken. Try another one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: It must be at least 15 characters long. Try a phrase.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: It can be up to 128 characters long.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: It is too repetitive. Use a phrase with different words.
errors.PASSWORD_COMPROMISED: That password appeared in data breaches from other sites. Choose another one.
errors.RECOVERY_CODE_INVALID: The username or the recovery code is not correct.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or the password is not correct.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We could not validate the request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection to Rinde. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

list.title: Accounts
list.subtitle: Every place you keep money: your wallet, your bank, your card.
list.emptyTitle: You don't have any accounts yet
list.emptyBody: Open one for every place you keep money. Then you'll be able to record its income and expenses.

fields.name: Name
fields.currencyHelp: It can't be changed later. Bitcoin only in crypto wallets.

new.title: Open an account
new.subtitle: If you pick the wrong currency, archive the account and open another one.

detail.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Look for it in your accounts list.
detail.archivedExplain: It no longer shows in your list and can't be renamed. Its history is kept.
detail.archiveExplain: Removes it from your list and keeps its history. This can't be undone.
detail.confirmBody: It will no longer show in your list and can't be renamed. Its data is kept, but it can't be reactivated.
detail.noMovements: You haven't recorded any transactions in this account yet.

errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for the account.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_INVALID: Use up to 60 characters, with no invisible characters.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_NOT_ALLOWED: Bitcoin can only be kept in a crypto wallet. Pick another currency or change the type.
errors.ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED: The account is archived and can no longer be renamed.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We couldn't validate the request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: There's no connection to Rinde. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

list.title: Transactions
list.subtitle: Everything that came in and went out of your accounts.
list.emptyTitle: You haven't recorded any transactions yet
list.emptyBody: Record an expense or an income and you'll see your balances up to date.

form.subtitleNew: Record an expense or an income in one of your accounts.
form.subtitleEdit: The account can't be changed: moving money between accounts is another operation.
form.amountHelp: In {{currency}}, with no sign: the type says if it comes in or out.
form.dateHelp: When it happened, which isn't always when you record it.
form.noAccountsBody: A transaction always goes through an account. Open your first one and come back.

errors.AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter an amount in numbers, for example 15300.50.
errors.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount has to be greater than zero: the type says if it comes in or out.
errors.TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The amount doesn't match the account's currency.
errors.TRANSACTION_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date can't be in the future.
errors.TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION_INVALID: Use up to 120 characters, with no invisible characters.
errors.CATEGORY_NAME_INVALID: Use up to 40 characters, with no invisible characters.
errors.CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: That category is of the other type. Pick one from the list.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: It has transactions: it can't be deleted.
errors.CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a category with that name.
errors.ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED: That account is archived: it doesn't take new transactions.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: That request was already sent with different data. Reload and try again.
errors.CURSOR_INVALID: We couldn't continue the list. Reload the page.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We couldn't validate the request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: There's no connection to Rinde. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
